cards.name: Wizard Apprentice
cards.rulesText: When this card is played, draw an extra card from your deck.

cards.name: Grand Archmage
cards.rulesText: Spellcasting: Choose any tile within 2 spaces of this wizard and transform it into a Mountain or Swamp.

cards.name: Forest Guardian
cards.rulesText: Vigilance. Can move through Forest tiles without consuming movement points.

cards.name: Mountain Drake
cards.rulesText: Flying. Mountain Drake gets +1/+0 for each Mountain tile adjacently controlled.

cards.name: Swamp Behemoth
cards.rulesText: Trample. Swamp Behemoth can only be summoned on or adjacent to Swamp tiles.

cards.name: Plains Unicorn
cards.rulesText: Lifelink. Restores 1 health point to your Wizard Tower when played.

cards.name: Planar Portal
cards.rulesText: Allows summoning creatures from your library directly onto any controlled territory.
